notes.title: Dolls' Domain Xmas 2024 Event!
notes.content:
Play Dolls' Domain during the event period and collect decorations to decorate your Xmas tree with!

Decorations will be hidden within Level 5 for you to find! Pick them up to collect them, and then they will be available to place on your tree within the Cubby Hole in the menu area.

Event period is based on your local time:

 Start date: December 17th 2024
 End date: December 31st 2024

notes.title: Dolls' Domain v0.1.2
notes.content:
Changelog:

 Now playable on Steam Deck (via Proton / WINE) and macOS!
 Saves are now stored in Steam Cloud!
 Partial support for controllers has been added using SteamInput! (Note that UI navigation will still require a mouse/touchscreen, and some way to enter text if creating a new save file. Controller prompts are also not shown in the UI currently)
 Reduced build size
 The Poser now properly stops when the player sees her, and is less likely to shove her head and limbs through walls and doors
 In VR, your hand has a larger hitbox for grabbing items that now extends to your fingers to make picking items up easier and more intuitive
 In VR, the Chest of Drawers (present in Level 4 and 5) can now be grabbed from both handles for each of the drawers
 The volume of various objects/interactions have been adjusted
 Doors no longer creak when they are moved slowly
 The pulleys in level 4 have a small cooldown added to prevent them being activated more than once by accident
 Added souls to Her Dollhouse


Controller controls:
Left Stick: Player movement
Right Stick: Camera movement

R2 / Right Trigger: Interact
L2 / Left Trigger: Use

Cross / A / Bottom Button: Jump
Circle / B / Right Button: Crouch

R1 / Right Shoulder: Pick up object
L1 / Left Shoulder: Throw object
R3 / Right Stick Press: Pick up object
L3 / Left Stick Press: Throw object
Square / X / Left Button: Pick up object
Triangle / Y / Top Button: Throw object

D-Pad Left: Inventory slot 1
D-Pad Up: Inventory slot 2
D-Pad Right: Inventory slot 3
D-Pad Down: Toggle flashlight

OPTIONS / START: Pause menu

[PlayStation controller specific]
Finger touching right half of touchpad: Move camera with gyro sensor

[Steam Deck controller specific]
Finger touching right stick or touchpad: Move camera with gyro sensor

Right touchpad: Move camera
Right touchpad click: Interact

Left touchpad: (Same as D-Pad)

What's next:

 We're working on a release for Linux, but have run into some issues that will make this take longer
 We'll be continuing to look into the issue where the game can crash when unfocused and refocused, but we have struggled to reproduce this issue. If you have experienced this issue and have any information to provide us, please let us know via our Discord (https://discord.com/invite/wdW2E2MZ4F)
 We'll also be continuing to look into the issue where sometimes going AFK in VR causes the game to stop working. Likewise, if you have experienced the issue, please let us know via our Discord
 Beginning work on v0.2!

notes.title: v0.1.1 Minor fixes and tweaks!
notes.content:
In v0.1.1 the following fixes and tweaks have been made:

 Fixed an issue where the Discord API could cause the game to crash and Discord to be forced open
 In VR, the players finger works properly for pressing the keys on the Safe Keypad in Level 5
 In VR, the puzzle paper is now easier to take out of the drawer in Level 5
 When Checkpoints are enabled, activated checkpoints will have their related items disabled and the keys will be automatically placed in the keyhole
 Added souls to Her Dollhouse


Issues we are currently aware of and are still investigating/working on are:

 Game can crash when unfocused and refocused
 Sometimes going AFK in VR causes the game to stop working
 The Poser sometimes moves too much when you can see her
 The Poser can sometimes cause the player to get stuck in a corner
 In VR, can't grab items when the players fingers reach them
 Imbalance in sound volume of various objects/interactions

notes.title: What we're working on!
notes.content:
Thank you all for purchasing and playing Dolls' Domain!

We've been enjoying watching you play and are taking every bit of feedback into account! Here's a list of the things we've picked up so far that we intend to prioritise fixing and investigating in the coming days:

Bugs/Issues:

 Game can crash when unfocused and refocused
 Sometimes going AFK in VR causes the game to stop working
 The Poser sometimes moves too much when you can see her
 The Poser can sometimes cause the player to get stuck in a corner
 In VR, can't grab items when the players fingers reach them
 In VR, the players finger doesn't work for pressing keys on the Safe Keypad in Level 5
 In VR, the puzzle paper in the drawer is hard to take out in Level 5


Tweaks:

 The door sounds make too much noise when moving slowly (and in general is quite loud compared to everything else)
 Keys and related items shouldn't show when the corresponding door has been unlocked by Checkpoints


We'll be trying our best to sort these as soon as possible for you! We thank you for your patience with us as we are only 3 people.

notes.title: Dolls' Domain Release!
notes.content:
You can enter your nightmare RIGHT NOW!
Dolls' Domain is available for purchase on Steam, with 20% off during the first week of release!
